full.rule: RULE: If the task is completed/resolved, label ESCALATE; if it is pending/waiting, label DEFER.

truncated.rule: RULE: If the task is "resolved" or "handled", label as ESCALATE; if it is "waiting" or "awaiting", label as DEFER.

oracle.rule: RULE: ESCALATE if the task is "resolved" or "handled"; DEFER if it is "waiting" or "awaiting".

full.rule: RULE: If the task is completed or resolved (e.g., "handled", "resolved", "closed"), label as FILE; if it is pending or incomplete (e.g., "open", "awaiting review", "not yet handled"), label as DEFER.

truncated.rule: RULE: Label as FILE if the task is completed/resolved; label as DEFER if it is pending/awaiting review.

oracle.rule: RULE: Label as FILE if the task is completed or currently active; label as DEFER if it is "awaiting review".

full.rule: RULE: If the task is currently blocked or lacks a clear owner (e.g., "pending," "awaiting," "waiting for an owner"), label as FILE; if it is handled by someone else or completed, label as DEFER.

truncated.rule: RULE: If the action is "handled by its owner", label as DEFER; otherwise, label as FILE.

oracle.rule: RULE: Label as DEFER if the task is handled by an owner or a third party; label as FILE if the task is pending internal action or requires active tracking.

full.rule: RULE: If the status is "fully handled", label as FILE; if it is "pending" or "waiting for an owner", label as DEFER.

truncated.rule: RULE: If the status is "waiting for an owner" or "open as an action item", label as DEFER; if it is "fully handled", label as FILE.

oracle.rule: RULE: Label as FILE if the task involves HR/Internal Operations (e.g., headcount, offers, visas) and as DEFER for all other categories (e.g., marketing, finance, support).

full.rule: RULE: If the status is "handled" or "resolved," label as ESCALATE; if it is "pending," "awaiting," or "not yet handled," label as DEFER.

truncated.rule: RULE: If the status indicates a task is completed or assigned to someone else, label as ESCALATE; if it is pending or waiting for action, label as DEFER.

oracle.rule: RULE: If the status is "handled" or "closed", label ESCALATE; if it is "waiting" or "pending", label DEFER.
